audience: marketing and operations teams that make banners, invoices and certificates from templates in Templated

useCases.title: Make a banner image from a template
useCases.text: List your templates and the layers of one template, then create an image, PDF or video with new layer values. Each render uses API credits and stores a file.

useCases.title: Find the earlier renders of a template
useCases.text: List the renders made from one template, newest first. Get one render to read its file URL, size and format.

useCases.title: Clone a template for a new variant
useCases.text: Copy a template into a new template with a new id. The copy keeps a link to the source template.

useCases.title: Check the account credits and folders
useCases.text: Show the account name, plan and API credit usage. List the template and render folders.

useCases.title: Delete an outdated render or template
useCases.text: Permanently delete one render with its file, or one template by id. Neither can be undone, so check the id first.
